title: devfront.dev Product and MVP Plan
agentInstruction: Read the JSON sidecar first. Use the HTML only for human and visual context.
goal: Validate that real development work can create a motivating visible world-building loop.
summary: Build a focused 2D personal-world vertical slice before GitHub automation, worlds, guilds, 3D or monetization.

decisions.decision: The world is the product center, mission board is utility.
decisions.rationale: Visible world growth is the primary emotional reward.
Validate the reward loop before expensive 3D or multiplayer work.
GitHub is the gold standard but real work can be private.

constraints: Real work output must remain central
MVP missions represent roughly 1 to 4 hours
Completion produces skill XP, resources and visible world progress
doNotDo: No guilds or PvP in MVP

implementationSequence.title: Playable World Prototype
implementationSequence.description: Create a clickable 2D world, mission selection and reward sequence.
acceptanceCriteria: Core loop is understandable without explanation
At least three mission types work

implementationSequence.title: Five-user loop test
implementationSequence.description: Observe comprehension and motivation with five target users.
acceptanceCriteria: Users identify the next world goal
Feedback distinguishes useful progress from cosmetic points

implementationSequence.title: MVP domain model
implementationSequence.description: Model missions, evidence, rewards, resources, skills, world elements and transformations.
acceptanceCriteria: Model supports manual and GitHub-verified missions
No multiplayer assumptions leak into MVP

risks: Game layer may detach from actual work
handoffPrompt: Build the devfront.dev playable 2D vertical slice described in this plan. Start with the world-centered core loop. Do not add 3D, guilds, PvP, monetization or a global leaderboard. Verify the completion reward visibly transforms the world.
